title: Where can you fly direct from Gatwick Airport?
author: Matt
intro: Gatwick is easyJet's biggest base and has flights to most of Europe, plus long-haul routes to the Caribbean, the USA and the Gulf. This is also Jet2's first winter at Gatwick, with new flights to La Palma, Agadir, Egypt and the ski resorts. Here's what flies and how to choose.
seo_title: Gatwick direct flights: Jet2's first winter (2026)
seo_description: easyJet and BA fly most routes, and new this winter Jet2 adds La Palma, Agadir, Sharm, Hurghada, ski flights and Christmas markets. Checked Nov 2026.

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
- **Biggest airline:** easyJet
- **New this winter:** Jet2's first season
- **Long-haul:** Caribbean, USA and Gulf
- **Ski flights:** Geneva, Salzburg and more

We checked these routes in November 2026. Routes and days of the week change every season, so check the airline's timetable before you plan a trip around one.

sections.heading: Who flies from Gatwick
sections.text:
easyJet is Gatwick's biggest airline, with flights to cities, beaches and ski airports all over Europe. British Airways flies short-haul routes and much of its leisure long-haul from Gatwick, and TUI flies package holidays to the sun.

Jet2 opened its Gatwick base in spring 2026, and this is its first winter there. Other airlines add more choice, including Emirates and Qatar Airways to the Gulf, where you can connect onwards to Asia and Australia. Our guide to [how early to arrive at Gatwick](/blog/how-early-should-you-arrive-at-gatwick-airport) covers the North and South terminals.

sections.heading: New for winter 2026/27
sections.text:
| Destination | Airline | Why go |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [La Palma](/destinations/la-palma) | Jet2 | quiet Canary island, about 20°C |
| [Agadir](/destinations/agadir) | Jet2 | Moroccan beach resort |
| [Sharm el-Sheikh](/destinations/sharm-el-sheikh) | Jet2 | Red Sea diving and sun |
| [Hurghada](/destinations/hurghada) | Jet2 | Red Sea resorts |
| [Salzburg](/destinations/salzburg) | Jet2 | skiing and Christmas markets |
| [Gdańsk](/destinations/gdansk) | Jet2 | Christmas markets |
| [Nuremberg](/destinations/nuremberg) | easyJet | Christmas markets, from 2 November |
| [Cagliari](/destinations/cagliari) | easyJet | Sardinia out of season |

Jet2's Gatwick programme also includes ski flights to Geneva, Grenoble, Turin and Chambéry, and Christmas market flights to [Cologne](/destinations/cologne). La Palma is weekly, so the flight day decides your trip.

Watch out: UK visitors need a visa for Egypt, which you can buy online or on arrival. Check the current entry rules on the UK government's travel advice pages before you book.

sections.heading: Winter sun
sections.text:
For guaranteed warmth in December to February, the Canaries are the safest bet, at about 20 to 23°C by day. There are direct flights from Gatwick to [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife), [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote), [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria) and [Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura), and now La Palma with Jet2.

For something further, the Red Sea is warmer still, and Jet2's new [Sharm el-Sheikh](/destinations/sharm-el-sheikh) and [Hurghada](/destinations/hurghada) flights add to the existing choice. [Madeira](/destinations/madeira) and [Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech) are milder options, better for walking and sightseeing than lying on a beach.

sections.heading: Ski flights
sections.text:
Gatwick has one of the widest choices of ski flights in the UK. easyJet and BA fly to the main Alpine airports, and Jet2 adds its own ski flights and packages this winter:

- **Geneva:** for the French and Swiss Alps, including Chamonix and Val Thorens.
- **Salzburg:** for the Austrian resorts, and the city's Christmas markets.
- **Grenoble and Chambéry:** for the big French ski areas.
- **Turin:** for the Italian Alps.

Tip: ski bags cost extra on most airlines. Book them with the flight, as adding them at the airport usually costs more. Our [best ski resorts for a weekend from the UK](/blog/best-ski-resorts-for-a-weekend-from-the-uk) guide has resort ideas.

sections.heading: Long-haul
sections.text: Gatwick is London's main airport for long-haul leisure flights. British Airways flies to the Caribbean, including [Barbados](/destinations/barbados), [Antigua](/destinations/antigua) and [St Lucia](/destinations/st-lucia), and to [Orlando](/destinations/orlando). Emirates flies to [Dubai](/destinations/dubai), and other airlines fly to North America and Asia. These routes are often seasonal or a few times a week, so check the timetable for your dates. For more ideas, see our [winter sun from Gatwick in January](/blog/winter-sun-from-gatwick-in-january) guide.

sections.heading: Where could you go from Gatwick?
sections.text:
For a week of winter sun, try [La Palma](/destinations/la-palma), [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife) or [Sharm el-Sheikh](/destinations/sharm-el-sheikh). For a festive break, look at [Nuremberg](/destinations/nuremberg) or [Salzburg](/destinations/salzburg). For a big trip, [Barbados](/destinations/barbados) and [Orlando](/destinations/orlando) are direct. The [ski holidays](/destinations/ski-holidays) and [Christmas holidays](/destinations/christmas-holidays) pages have more ideas.

If your family can't agree, read our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday), or add a few ideas to somewhere.party and let the draw decide.

faqs.question: Which airlines fly from Gatwick Airport?
faqs.answer: easyJet is the biggest, followed by British Airways. TUI, Jet2, Emirates, Qatar Airways and many other airlines fly from Gatwick too.

faqs.question: Does Jet2 fly from Gatwick?
faqs.answer: Yes. Jet2 opened its Gatwick base in spring 2026, and winter 2026/27 is its first winter there, with winter sun, ski and Christmas market flights.

faqs.question: Can you fly direct from Gatwick to La Palma?
faqs.answer: Yes. Jet2 has added a weekly flight from Gatwick to La Palma for winter 2026/27. Check the day of the week before booking a hotel.

faqs.question: Can you fly from Gatwick to the Caribbean?
faqs.answer: Yes. British Airways flies direct from Gatwick to several Caribbean islands, including Barbados, Antigua and St Lucia.
